name: Haus Alpina
beschreibung:
Peacefully located in the picturesque Thiersee valley, Haus Alpina welcomes visitors with cosy rooms and genuine Tyrolean warmth. It provides a delightful setting for nature lovers and families.

Lake Thiersee, trails leading up Mount Pendling, and the town of Kufstein are within easy reach.
kurzbeschreibung: Haus Alpina in Thiersee offers restful holidays framed by alpine mountains and the pristine lake.
